analysis.visual_description: The foul papers of the last scene, by one candle. The messenger's exchange is underlined, not struck. No hand is in the frame.
A softer ending is begun under those lines and struck through. The pen lies in the gutter.
The same leaf. A short order in the margin, and a pause-mark after the ladies' refusal. The words of the refusal are not struck.
Lower on the same opening, a line he is not rewriting tonight. The candle is his.
